profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company, traded as DELL, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Its site describes it as providing technology solutions, services and support, and it sells laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming products and accessories. It also markets Dell Premier, which it describes as customizing an organization's IT experience, including buying, management and support.

The site's own promotional material features Copilot+ PCs, which it describes as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, alongside the XPS 13 and Dell 14 Plus. The site also lists standard terms such as a 30-day return period calculated from invoice date and expedited delivery that is unavailable on certain TVs, monitors, batteries and adapters and is limited to the continental U.S. outside Alaska.

The company's recorded law exposure is in Texas, with 126 cases. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0001571996.
